After a thrilling Game 1 at the Chase Center, the Golden State Valkyries and visiting Atlanta Dream are set to run it back in Ballhalla for Game 2 of the WNBA Finals. Golden State holds a 1-0 series lead, but the Dream showed they are ready to put up a hard fight.
 Ahead of Game 2, Angel Reese pulled up to the arena and showed she was all business in a stunning all-black dress. Reese kept things casual in the opening game of the series, but she's upping the fashion game for the Finals redux.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Reese paired the flowing dress with some white kitten heels and a white Gucci horsebit bag. She's dressed like she's ready to drop thirty and even the series.
 You can check out a closer look at Reese's pre-game fight for Monday night's game below.
 MORE: Angel Reese rocks Barbie x Reebok collab for WNBA Finals debut 
 Angel Reese Brings Extra Flair To Game 2
 That's how it's done.
 Reese made a statement with her pre-game look, and now the Dream will be hoping she can make a statement on the court in Game 2. Reese struggled down the stretch in the opening game of the series, going scoreless in the second half after putting up 14 points through the first two quarters, so she's hoping to bounce back in a big.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement MORE: Angel Reese gives subtle nod to Maryland at Ravens-Falcons with $9k Chanel bag 
 Game 2 between the Dream and Valkyries is set to tip-off at 8:00 p.m. ET on the USA Network, CNBC, and E!, with live streaming available on Peacock. The Valkyries are slight 1.5-point favorites at home, while the over/under is set for 152.5 total points.
